units.speaker: Anna
units.text: But that is not where the story ends, is it?

units.speaker: Ben
units.text: No. The guilds, whose houses lined the square, rebuilt them, and the square was restored in about four years.

units.speaker: Anna
units.text: Which is why, when you stand in the Grand Place today, you are looking at a city that chose to rebuild rather than give up.

units.speaker: Ben
units.text: Well said. That's the end of the demo.

units.speaker: Ben
units.text: If you like this format, ask for any history as a conversation between two hosts.
